newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire TV gains as bid hopes re-emerge.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire TV gains as bid hopes re-emerge.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Tyne-Tees Television Holdings rose 12-1/2 pence to 1,280 on Friday as hopes resurfaced that Granada would launch a takeover bid.
Turnover in Yorkshire Tyne-Tees TV was, however, a meagre 1,790 shares.

Bid expectations were raised as new, more relaxed cross-media ownership rules came into force today, market makers said. The new government rules end the two-licence limit on control of commercial television franchises. It is replaced by an ownership ceiling of 15 percent of televsion audience.
Granada owns over 24 percent of Yorkshire Tyne-Tees TV shares and said in September it had an open mind about a full bid for Yorkshire.
